title: Accept a delivery only on a read-only, candidate-bound, synthetic owner-inspection record

facts.note: Common prerequisite for every firing: Flow actually tracks the delivery with an owner-inspection/v1 record (acknowledged or not) AND the delivery is about to be accepted / marked done. Needs a workflow observer reading Flow state; the unacknowledged finding applies only in done mode.
Discovery hint only; a task-term mention is not proof that Flow tracks the delivery and never fires the rule on its own.
Emitted by the read-only checkOwnerInspection capability over the record Flow already read and the candidate commit + tracked-file reader.
Diff/commit-level facts that make a previously published record stale.

fires: A delivery Flow tracks with an owner-inspection/v1 record is about to be accepted.
A Flow-tracked delivery is about to be accepted and its record's provenance.commit differs from the candidate commit, or its merge record cites no candidate record.

A Flow-tracked delivery is about to be accepted and its record targets production, a URL other than a credential-free 127.0.0.1 or localhost URL, or a sandbox/preview target lacking explicit authorization of owner directive M-20261011T121147Z.
A Flow-tracked delivery is about to be marked done and operator@desk has not yet acknowledged its record (the rule fires and reports unacknowledged).
A Flow-tracked delivery of a served surface is about to be accepted and its record states rendered N/A.
doesNotFire: A delivery that Flow does not track with an owner-inspection/v1 record, even if the task text mentions owner inspection.
Work on a Flow-tracked delivery that is not yet being accepted or marked done.
Judging whether a journey or its health/smoke evidence genuinely proves the stated scenario (owned by the checklist and atdd-bun.review.behavioral-reconciliation).

given: A delivery Flow tracks with an owner-inspection/v1 record that Flow owns and publishes and that Flow has already read (consumed by Bun via the exact-pinned @afokapu/atdd-flow type). Flow exclusively owns acknowledgement, which may still be missing; an unacknowledged record is in scope and must be checked.
when: The delivery is about to be accepted or marked done for a candidate commit.
then: Accept only if the record fits that exact candidate: published for its commit, tracked evidence digests matching, target a credential-free 127.0.0.1 or localhost URL, data_classification exactly `synthetic`, both a teardown reference and its digest present, N/A only for a toolkit surface with rationale and a Flow-defined direct evidence kind, and operator@desk acknowledgement before done.
prefer: Report FAIL when any finding applies; report COULD_NOT_CHECK for evidence that is not a tracked path (e.g. a CI run URL) or a tracked path that cannot be read; PASS only when no finding applies and every evidence reference was verified against tracked bytes.
Require republishing through Flow when the candidate or an evidence file changed.
Require only synthetic data, a credential-free 127.0.0.1/localhost target, and recorded teardown evidence (reference + digest).
Confirm the record is read only via the exact-pinned @afokapu/atdd-flow type; treat `synthetic` as Bun applicability policy, not a Flow schema constraint (Flow's field is free text).
avoid: Editing, writing, publishing, storing or copying the record into Bun state, or creating parallel manifest/registry/schema/report/preview/acknowledgement/dependency state; Flow alone owns its shape, publication, acknowledgement and cleanup lifecycle, Bun only reports findings.
Production targets, deploys, implicit previews or fabricated URLs; sandbox/preview targets without explicit authorization of owner directive M-20261011T121147Z.
Promoting COULD_NOT_CHECK (untracked or unreadable evidence) to PASS.
Skipping the check for a record because it is not yet acknowledged.
unless: A toolkit repository with no served surface states rendered N/A with an exact rationale and direct evidence of a Flow-defined N/A kind (CI run, gate report, or package listing); it is never given a fabricated URL.
why: Owner inspection proves a delivery only if this exact candidate was inspected safely and the owner saw it; Bun reading, not writing, keeps Flow the single source of truth.
evidence: checkOwnerInspection returns PASS only when no finding applies and every evidence reference was verified against tracked bytes.
Evidence that is not a tracked path (e.g. a CI run URL) or a tracked path that cannot be read returns COULD_NOT_CHECK, never PASS.
No Bun-side file writes, copies or parallel state for the record exist in the diff; the record is consumed only via the exact-pinned @afokapu/atdd-flow type.

Whether a journey or its health/smoke evidence genuinely proves the scenario (decorative journey) is not machine-checkable from a read-only record; that judgment stays with the checklist and the independent semantic review required by atdd-bun.review.behavioral-reconciliation.
verifier_detail: Capability `checkOwnerInspection(record, candidate)`: a read-only consumer check over the Flow-owned inspection record. record = the atdd-workflow/owner-inspection/v1 record that Flow has already read (published through Flow; Flow exclusively owns its acknowledgement, which may be absent — in done mode an unacknowledged record yields the unacknowledged finding); Bun reads it via the exact-pinned @afokapu/atdd-flow type. candidate = commit + reader over tracked files.

Seven deterministic findings: stale-candidate (provenance.commit differs from candidate, or merge record cites no candidate record); evidence-digest-mismatch (tracked evidence path no longer matches recorded sha256); non-local-target (target not a credential-free 127.0.0.1 or localhost local URL; sandbox and preview targets reported citing owner directive M-20261011T121147Z); non-synthetic-data (data_classification not exactly `synthetic`); missing-teardown (teardown reference or its digest absent); invalid-not-applicable (rendered N/A on non-toolkit surface, without rationale, or without a Flow-defined direct N/A evidence kind); unacknowledged (done mode, operator@desk has not acknowledged).
`synthetic` is Bun applicability policy: Flow's data_classification field is free text and the policy is not a Flow schema constraint; compare exactly.
Result states: PASS / FAIL / COULD_NOT_CHECK; COULD_NOT_CHECK is never promoted to PASS.
The check applies no production target, deploy, implicit preview, or fabricated URL; sandbox/preview without explicit owner-directive M-20261011T121147Z authorization is a finding.

splitSuggestion.then: ATDD Bun never writes, publishes, stores, copies or edits the Flow-owned owner-inspection record nor creates parallel manifest/registry/schema/report/preview/acknowledgement/dependency state; Flow alone owns its lifecycle.

additions.text: The read-only/Flow-ownership obligation (S007, S010, S038–S039) is independent of the candidate-acceptance obligation; kept in avoid[0] and proposed as atdd-bun.review.owner-inspection-read-only.

additions.justification: Source has no explicit rationale field; wording paraphrases source intent only.

additions.text: avoid[3]: do not skip the check for a record because it is not yet acknowledged.
additions.justification: Restates source S006/S022 (acknowledgement checked before done; unacknowledged is a finding) to prevent treating acknowledgement as an applicability prerequisite; no new obligation.

additions.text: Coder-facing text exceeds ~1,000 characters because then enumerates all seven acceptance conditions with exact target allowlist and teardown reference+digest, and prefer states the PASS/FAIL/COULD_NOT_CHECK result semantics.
additions.justification: Losslessness wins over brevity; reviewers need exact thresholds.

trace.note: Acknowledgement is an acceptance condition in then, not a precondition in given.
Record is published through Flow; Flow owns acknowledgement, which may still be missing.
